title: Assessing LEO Satellite Networks for National Emergency Failover
authors: Vaibhav Bhosale; Ying Zhang; Sameer Kapoor; Robin Kim; Miguel Schlicht; Muskaan Gupta; Ekaterina Tumanova; Zachary S. Bischof; Fabián E. Bustamante; Alberto Dainotti; Ahmed Saeed
affiliations: Georgia Institute of Technology, Northwestern University
research_focus: Capacity planning, Network topology, Routing / Load balancing

problem_statement.en: Population placement, RF beams, spectrum reuse, gateways and policy jointly cap country-scale backup capacity.
problem_statement.zh: population placement、RF beams、spectrum reuse、gateways 與 policy 共同限制 country-scale backup capacity。

key_innovation.en: Build a capacity graph with beam and interference constraints; allocate terminals and RF resources, then solve global or policy-restricted capacity flows.
key_innovation.zh: 建立含 beam 與 interference constraints 的 capacity graph；配置 terminals、RF resources，再解 global 或 policy-restricted capacity flows。

baselines_compared: Population placement, greedy capacity balancing, domestic/global TE

key_improvements.en: Table 1 bounds range from 41 Gbps for Tonga to 4,653 Gbps for South Africa; comparison to lost cable capacity ranges from 0.9% for Great Britain to 434% for Haiti.
key_improvements.zh: Table 1 的 bounds 從 Tonga 41 Gbps 到 South Africa 4,653 Gbps；與 lost cable capacity 比較從 Great Britain 0.9% 到 Haiti 434%。

node_count: Six country scenarios, up to 50,000 modeled terminals

evidence: §3 capacity graph and allocation; §4 data; §5 six case studies, Table 1–2; PDF pp.4–11

scope.en: Capacity values are optimistic graph bounds conditioned on terminal placement and RF configuration. The represented interference model covers intra-satellite reuse; weather, terrain and inter-satellite interference motivate refinement.
scope.zh: capacity values 為以 terminal placement 與 RF configuration 為條件的 optimistic graph bounds。interference model 涵蓋 intra-satellite reuse；weather、terrain 與 inter-satellite interference 提供 refinement 方向。

model.en: NetworkX max-flow/min-cost capacity bounds; geometric beam feasibility; greedy capacity balancing and terminal-placement heuristics.
model.zh: NetworkX max-flow/min-cost capacity bounds；geometric beam feasibility；greedy capacity balancing 與 terminal-placement heuristics。

evaluation.en: Six real cable-failure case studies using RIPE Atlas and Calypso route/cable mappings; modeled Starlink regulatory configurations and terminal-count sweeps up to 50,000.
evaluation.zh: 六個真實 cable-failure case studies 使用 RIPE Atlas 與 Calypso route/cable mappings；採 modeled Starlink regulatory configurations，掃描最高 50,000 terminals。
